blocks.zh: 導論  |  中文解說
blocks.en: Introduction  |  Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：這份指引在解釋什麼？
blocks.en: Core concept: what does this guidance explain?

blocks.zh: FDA 於 2013 年 1 月 22 日正式發布 21 CFR Part 4（最終法規），這份 2017 年的指引文件是對該法規的說明書。重點在於：
blocks.en: FDA formally issued 21 CFR Part 4 (the final rule) on January 22, 2013, and this 2017 guidance document is its explanatory manual. The key points are:

blocks.zh: Part 4 沒有創造新要求——它只是澄清現有的藥品、器械、生物製品 CGMP 如何適用於組合產品
blocks.en: Part 4 created no new requirements. It only clarifies how the existing drug, device and biologic CGMP requirements apply to combination products.

blocks.zh: 在 Part 4 之前，業界面臨的困境是：不知道對一個「藥器合一」產品，應該遵循哪套 CGMP
blocks.en: Before Part 4, industry faced a dilemma: it was unclear which set of CGMP to follow for a "drug-device" product.

blocks.zh: Part 4 的核心貢獻是建立了一個透明且精簡的法規遵循框架
blocks.en: Part 4's core contribution is a transparent and streamlined compliance framework.

blocks.zh: 比喻：交通法規的跨縣市適用
blocks.en: Analogy: traffic rules across county lines

blocks.zh: 想像一輛車同時行駛在兩個縣市的邊界道路上。Part 4 之前，沒有人說清楚該遵循哪個縣市的法規。Part 4 就是那份「跨界道路適用規則說明書」——它不新增速限，只告訴你哪個速限適用，以及有沒有方法讓兩套規則同時被滿足。
blocks.en: Imagine a car driving on a road along the border between two counties. Before Part 4, nobody said clearly which county's rules applied. Part 4 is the "rulebook for border roads": it adds no new speed limits, it only tells you which limit applies and whether there is a way to satisfy both sets of rules at once.

blocks.zh: 法律效力提示
blocks.en: Note on legal status

blocks.zh: 這份指引文件（Guidance）本身不具法律強制效力，僅代表 FDA 目前的思考方向。但 Part 4 本身（21 CFR part 4）是正式法規，具法律效力。兩者要分清楚。
blocks.en: This guidance document is not legally enforceable; it only represents FDA's current thinking. Part 4 itself (21 CFR part 4), however, is a formal regulation with legal force. Keep the two clearly separate.

blocks.zh: 法規時間軸速查
blocks.en: Regulatory timeline at a glance

blocks.zh: 2013-01-22：21 CFR Part 4 最終法規正式發布
blocks.en: 2013-01-22: 21 CFR Part 4 final rule formally issued

blocks.zh: 2017-01：本份指引文件發布，對 Part 4 提供詳細解釋
blocks.en: 2017-01: this guidance issued, giving a detailed explanation of Part 4

blocks.zh: 2026-02-02：QMSR 生效（詳見後段說明）
blocks.en: 2026-02-02: QMSR takes effect (see later in this section)

blocks.zh: II.A 定義  |  中文解說
blocks.en: II.A Definition  |  Commentary

blocks.zh: PFS 就是最典型的 Single-entity
blocks.en: The PFS is the classic single-entity product

blocks.zh: 以無菌充填 CDMO 的日常工作為例：預充式注射器（Pre-filled Syringe, PFS）是藥液（藥品）與注射器（醫療器械）物理合一的產品，是最標準的「單一實體型組合產品」。
blocks.en: Take the daily work of an aseptic fill-finish CDMO as an example: the pre-filled syringe (PFS) is a product in which the drug solution (drug) and the syringe (medical device) are physically combined, making it the standard "single-entity combination product".

blocks.zh: 相較之下，如果一個試劑盒裡有一支空針筒和一個獨立藥瓶，就是「共包裝型」。
blocks.en: By contrast, a kit containing an empty syringe and a separate vial of drug is a "co-packaged" product.

blocks.zh: 「構成部分」的法律意義
blocks.en: The legal meaning of "constituent part"

blocks.zh: Constituent parts（構成部分）這個術語很重要：它指的是組合進組合產品的各個藥品、器械或生物製品本身。它們各自保留原有的法規地位（drug、device 或 biologic），不因被組合而改變。這直接影響後續哪些 CGMP 適用。
blocks.en: Constituent parts is an important term: it refers to the individual drug, device or biological product that is combined into the combination product. Each keeps its own original regulatory status (drug, device or biologic) and does not change because it has been combined. This directly affects which CGMP requirements apply.

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Practice question

blocks.zh: 一家公司生產了一種吸入器，裝填了特定的哮喘藥物，並以整體產品銷售。請問這是哪種類型的組合產品？
blocks.en: A company manufactures an inhaler pre-loaded with a specific asthma drug and sells it as a single product. What type of combination product is this?

blocks.zh: 提示：整支產品一體成型，藥物與器械物理合一出廠。
blocks.en: Hint: the whole product is made as one unit, and the drug and device are shipped physically combined.

blocks.zh: 答：Single-entity combination product（單一實體型）。
blocks.en: Answer: a single-entity combination product.

blocks.zh: II.B 品質基礎  |  中文解說
blocks.en: II.B Quality Foundations  |  Commentary

blocks.zh: 比喻：CGMP 是「最低標準的建築法規」
blocks.en: Analogy: CGMP is a "minimum-standard building code"

blocks.zh: CGMP 就像建築法規：它規定了最低安全標準，但不阻止你蓋得更好。它不是品質的保證，而是進入市場的「門檻」。對組合產品來說，難題在於：藥品建築法規和器械建築法規有不同的要求，Part 4 告訴你怎麼同時達標。
blocks.en: CGMP is like a building code: it sets the minimum safety standard but does not stop you from building better. It does not guarantee quality; it is the "threshold" for entering the market. For a combination product the difficulty is that the drug "building code" and the device "building code" have different requirements, and Part 4 tells you how to meet both at the same time.

blocks.zh: QS vs. QMSR — 2026 年重要更新
blocks.en: QS vs. QMSR: an important 2026 update

blocks.zh: 本指引發布時（2017年），器械 CGMP 稱為「Quality System（QS）Regulation」（21 CFR Part 820）。自 2026 年 2 月 2 日起，Part 820 更新為 Quality Management System Regulation（QMSR），與 ISO 13485:2016 高度一致化。
blocks.en: When this guidance was issued (2017), the device CGMP was called the "Quality System (QS) Regulation" (21 CFR Part 820). Effective February 2, 2026, Part 820 was updated to the Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR), which is closely harmonized with ISO 13485:2016.

blocks.zh: 閱讀本指引時，凡提到「Part 820」或「QS regulation」，均應理解為現行的 QMSR。
blocks.en: When reading this guidance, any mention of "Part 820" or the "QS regulation" should be understood as referring to the current QMSR.

blocks.zh: II.C 法規概覽  |  中文解說
blocks.en: II.C Final Rule Overview  |  Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心原則：構成部分保留其法規地位
blocks.en: Core principle: constituent parts keep their regulatory status

blocks.zh: 這是 Part 4 最根本的邏輯：把藥品和器械組合在一起，不會讓藥品「變成」器械，也不會讓器械「變成」藥品。每個構成部分保留原有的法規身分，因此其各自的 CGMP 要求都必須被滿足。
blocks.en: This is the most fundamental logic of Part 4: combining a drug and a device does not turn the drug into a device, nor the device into a drug. Each constituent part retains its original regulatory identity, so the CGMP requirements for each must still be met.

blocks.zh: 問題是：如何同時滿足兩套 CGMP？這就是 Part 4 要解決的問題。
blocks.en: The question is: how do you satisfy two sets of CGMP at once? That is the problem Part 4 solves.

blocks.zh: 「CGMP Operating System」是什麼？
blocks.en: What is the "CGMP operating system"?

blocks.zh: 這是本指引引入的操作性概念，指工廠內部為滿足組合產品 CGMP 要求而設計和實施的整套品質運作體系。它包括：
blocks.en: This is an operational concept introduced by the guidance. It refers to the complete set of quality arrangements a facility designs and implements to meet the CGMP requirements for a combination product. It includes:

blocks.zh: SOP、記錄、訓練體系
blocks.en: SOPs, records and training system

blocks.zh: QMS 架構（CAPA、設計管控、採購管控等）
blocks.en: QMS framework (CAPA, design controls, purchasing controls, etc.)

blocks.zh: 廠房、設備、人員的管控系統
blocks.en: Control systems for facilities, equipment and personnel

blocks.zh: 工廠的品質文件體系必須清楚識別出這套 Operating System。
blocks.en: The facility's quality documentation must clearly identify this operating system.

blocks.zh: 比喻：Option 1 vs Option 2
blocks.en: Analogy: Option 1 vs Option 2

blocks.zh: Option 1 就像同時取得兩張駕照（汽車 + 機車），每張駕照的所有要求都要全部符合，不省略任何一項。工作量最大，但也最沒有爭議。
blocks.en: Option 1 is like holding two driver's licenses at once (car + motorcycle): every requirement of each license must be met in full, with nothing omitted. It is the most work, but also the least open to dispute.

blocks.zh: Option 2（精簡路徑）則像「整合考照」——以一張駕照為主體，再補考另一種車的關鍵科目。大幅減少重複性要求，但需要清楚知道補哪些科目。
blocks.en: Option 2 (the streamlined approach) is like an "integrated license test": you take one license as the base and then take only the key subjects for the other type of vehicle. It greatly reduces duplicated requirements, but you need to know exactly which subjects to add.

blocks.zh: 精簡路徑解析  |  中文解說
blocks.en: Streamlined Approaches Explained  |  Commentary

blocks.zh: 兩種精簡路徑的邏輯結構
blocks.en: The logic of the two streamlined approaches

blocks.zh:
路徑 A：藥品 CGMP 為基礎
= 21 CFR 210/211（全套）
+ Part 820 的 6 條關鍵器械條款
（管理責任、設計管控、採購、CAPA、安裝、服務）

路徑 B：器械 QS 為基礎（現為 QMSR）
= 21 CFR 820 全套（ISO 13485 對齊）
+ 21 CFR 211 的 8 條關鍵藥品條款
（組件測試、產率計算、防竄改包裝、效期、
 測試放行、穩定性、特殊測試、留存樣品）
blocks.en:
Approach A: drug CGMP-based
= 21 CFR 210/211 (in full)
+ 6 key device provisions from Part 820
(management responsibility, design controls, purchasing, CAPA, installation, servicing)

Approach B: device QS-based (now QMSR)
= 21 CFR 820 in full (aligned with ISO 13485)
+ 8 key drug provisions from 21 CFR 211
(component testing, calculation of yield, tamper-evident packaging, expiration dating, release testing, stability testing, special testing requirements, reserve samples)

blocks.zh: 為什麼這 6 條 / 8 條被選中？
blocks.en: Why were these 6 / 8 provisions chosen?

blocks.zh: FDA 選擇這些條款是因為它們各自代表對方框架中「最無法被忽視的核心要素」：
blocks.en: FDA chose these provisions because each represents a core element of the other framework that "cannot be overlooked":

blocks.zh: 給藥品廠商加的 6 條器械條款：主要針對器械特有的設計管控（820.30）和 CAPA（820.100），這兩項在傳統藥品 CGMP 中沒有明確對應要求
blocks.en: The 6 device provisions added for drug manufacturers: these mainly address device-specific design controls (820.30) and CAPA (820.100), which have no explicit counterpart in traditional drug CGMP.

blocks.zh: 給器械廠商加的 8 條藥品條款：主要針對藥品特有的效期管理（211.137）、穩定性測試（211.166）、組件測試（211.84），這些在器械 QS 中沒有直接對應
blocks.en: The 8 drug provisions added for device manufacturers: these mainly address drug-specific expiration dating (211.137), stability testing (211.166) and component testing (211.84), which have no direct counterpart in the device QS.

blocks.zh: PMOA 決定主管中心，但不決定路徑選擇
blocks.en: PMOA determines the lead center, but not the approach chosen

blocks.zh: 這是本節最容易混淆的概念。Primary Mode of Action（PMOA） 只決定由哪個 FDA Center（CDER/CDRH/CBER）擔任主管中心，但不限制廠商選擇哪條精簡路徑。
blocks.en: This is the concept most easily confused in this section. The Primary Mode of Action (PMOA) only determines which FDA Center (CDER/CDRH/CBER) acts as lead center; it does not restrict which streamlined approach the manufacturer chooses.

blocks.zh: 舉例：一個 PFS（PMOA 是藥品），由 CDER 擔任主管中心，但廠商可以選擇「器械 QS 為基礎 + 8 條藥品條款」，而不一定要選「藥品 CGMP 為基礎」路徑。
blocks.en: Example: for a PFS whose PMOA is that of a drug, CDER is the lead center, but the manufacturer may choose "device QS-based + 8 drug provisions" and is not obliged to choose the "drug CGMP-based" approach.

blocks.zh: Cross-labeled 的例外
blocks.en: The exception for cross-labeled products

blocks.zh: 如果兩個構成部分在完全分開的設施製造，則各設施只需遵循自己那部分（藥品或器械）的法規，不需要用精簡路徑。精簡路徑主要適用於單一設施同時製造或組裝整個組合產品的情況。
blocks.en: If the two constituent parts are manufactured in completely separate facilities, each facility only needs to follow the regulations for its own part (drug or device) and does not need to use a streamlined approach. The streamlined approaches mainly apply where a single facility manufactures or assembles the entire combination product.

blocks.zh: 文件要求與主管中心  |  中文解說
blocks.en: Documentation Requirements and Lead Center  |  Commentary

blocks.zh: 文件準備要求：查驗時必須備妥
blocks.en: Documentation requirements: must be ready at inspection

blocks.zh: FDA 查驗時，廠商必須能夠清楚識別並立即提供所有用於證明 Part 4 合規的文件。這意味著品質系統文件（如品質手冊或程序書）必須明確寫明：
blocks.en: During an FDA inspection, the manufacturer must be able to clearly identify and promptly provide all documents used to demonstrate Part 4 compliance. This means the quality system documents (such as the quality manual or procedures) must state clearly:

blocks.zh: 工廠採用哪條精簡路徑（或 Option 1 全套合規）
blocks.en: Which streamlined approach the facility has adopted (or Option 1, full compliance)

blocks.zh: 對應的 CGMP 條款如何在廠內被實施
blocks.en: How the corresponding CGMP provisions are implemented on site

blocks.zh: 哪些 SOP、記錄、驗證文件涵蓋了哪些法規條款
blocks.en: Which SOPs, records and validation documents cover which regulatory provisions

blocks.zh: 2026 年重大更新：QS Reg → QMSR
blocks.en: Major 2026 update: QS Reg to QMSR

blocks.zh: 生效日：2026 年 2 月 2 日
blocks.en: Effective date: February 2, 2026

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 820（Quality System Regulation）正式更名並修訂為 QMSR（Quality Management System Regulation），與 ISO 13485:2016 高度一致化。
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 820 (Quality System Regulation) has been formally renamed and revised as the QMSR (Quality Management System Regulation), closely harmonized with ISO 13485:2016.

blocks.zh: 對組合產品廠商的影響：
blocks.en: Impact on combination product manufacturers:

blocks.zh: 選擇「器械 QS 為基礎」精簡路徑的廠商，現在要對照 QMSR 而非舊的 Part 820
blocks.en: Manufacturers that choose the "device QS-based" streamlined approach must now map to the QMSR rather than the old Part 820.

blocks.zh: QMSR 引入了 ISO 13485 的條款結構，與過去 Part 820 的條款編號有所不同
blocks.en: The QMSR adopts the clause structure of ISO 13485, which differs from the previous Part 820 numbering.

blocks.zh: 本指引文件（2017）中所有引用「Part 820」或「820.xx」的條款，在 QMSR 架構下需要重新映射
blocks.en: All references to "Part 820" or "820.xx" provisions in this guidance (2017) need to be re-mapped under the QMSR framework.

blocks.zh: 廠商應更新 QMS 文件，確保引用正確的現行法規版本
blocks.en: Manufacturers should update their QMS documents to make sure they cite the correct, current version of the regulation.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務觀點：選哪條精簡路徑？
blocks.en: CDMO practical view: which streamlined approach to choose?

blocks.zh: 對於以無菌充填為主業的 CDMO，這個策略決策至關重要：
blocks.en: For a CDMO whose main business is aseptic fill-finish, this strategic decision is critical:

blocks.zh: 藥品 CGMP 為基礎（路徑 A）：適合已建立完整 21 CFR 210/211 合規體系的藥品 CDMO。補加的 6 條器械條款中，820.30（設計管控）和 820.100（CAPA）對無菌充填 CDMO 影響最大，需要專門建立設計管控文件體系。
blocks.en: Drug CGMP-based (Approach A): suited to drug CDMOs that already have a complete 21 CFR 210/211 compliance system. Of the 6 added device provisions, 820.30 (design controls) and 820.100 (CAPA) have the greatest impact on an aseptic fill-finish CDMO and require a dedicated design control documentation system.

blocks.zh: 器械 QS 為基礎（路徑 B）：適合以器械製造為主的 CDMO 或已導入 ISO 13485 的廠商。補加的 8 條藥品條款中，211.137（效期）、211.166（穩定性）是關鍵新增要求。
blocks.en: Device QS-based (Approach B): suited to CDMOs focused mainly on device manufacturing or manufacturers that have already implemented ISO 13485. Of the 8 added drug provisions, 211.137 (expiration dating) and 211.166 (stability testing) are the key new requirements.

blocks.zh: 實務建議： 大多數無菌充填 CDMO 以藥品 CGMP 為核心，選路徑 A 最自然，但必須認真建立器械設計管控體系，不能僅以「這是 client 的設計」為由略過 820.30。
blocks.en: Practical recommendation: Most aseptic fill-finish CDMOs have drug CGMP at their core, so Approach A is the most natural choice, but they must seriously build a device design control system and cannot skip 820.30 simply because "this is the client's design".

blocks.zh: 主管中心（Lead Center）與 PMOA 的關係
blocks.en: Relationship between the lead center and PMOA

blocks.zh: OCP（Office of Combination Products）負責協助 PMOA 認定，以及跨部門協調。如果廠商對產品應歸哪個中心管有疑問，可向 OCP 提出 RFD（Request for Designation）。
blocks.en: The OCP (Office of Combination Products) helps determine the PMOA and coordinates across centers. If a manufacturer is unsure which center should be responsible for a product, it can submit an RFD (Request for Designation) to the OCP.

blocks.zh: 本節練習題 — 自我測驗
blocks.en: Practice Questions: Self-Assessment

blocks.zh: Q1. 一家 CDMO 生產預充式注射器（PFS），藥品的 PMOA 是藥理作用。請問：(a) 這是哪種類型的組合產品？(b) 主管中心是誰？(c) 廠商是否只能選擇「藥品 CGMP 為基礎」的精簡路徑？
blocks.en: Q1. A CDMO manufactures a pre-filled syringe (PFS) whose drug PMOA is pharmacological action. (a) What type of combination product is this? (b) Which is the lead center? (c) Is the manufacturer limited to the "drug CGMP-based" streamlined approach?

blocks.zh: 參考答案：(a) Single-entity combination product（b) CDER（c) 否，廠商可自由選擇兩條精簡路徑中的任一條。
blocks.en: Reference answer: (a) Single-entity combination product; (b) CDER; (c) No, the manufacturer is free to choose either of the two streamlined approaches.

blocks.zh: Q2. 選擇「器械 QS 為基礎」精簡路徑的廠商，需要額外遵循哪 8 條藥品 CGMP 條款？其中哪一條對無菌充填產品最關鍵？
blocks.en: Q2. A manufacturer choosing the "device QS-based" streamlined approach must additionally follow which 8 drug CGMP provisions? Which one is most critical for aseptic fill-finish products?
Reference answer: 211.84, 211.103, 211.132, 211.137, 211.165, 211.166, 211.167, 211.170. The most critical for aseptic fill-finish are 211.166 (stability testing) and 211.137 (expiration dating).

blocks.zh: Q3. 2026 年 2 月 2 日之後，CDMO 的 QMS 文件如果還引用「21 CFR 820.100 CAPA」，需要如何更新？
blocks.en: Q3. After February 2, 2026, if a CDMO's QMS documents still cite "21 CFR 820.100 CAPA", how should they be updated?

blocks.zh: 參考答案：Part 820 已更新為 QMSR，需更新 QMS 文件中的法規引用，並對照 QMSR 條款（ISO 13485:2016 架構）確認 CAPA 要求是否完全滿足。
blocks.en: Reference answer: Part 820 has been updated to the QMSR, so the regulatory references in the QMS documents must be updated, and the QMSR provisions (ISO 13485:2016 structure) must be checked to confirm that the CAPA requirements are fully met.
